results.title: ITUC-Africa, NLC pledge support for EFCC to fight corruption
results.description: The African Regional Organisation of the International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC-Africa) and the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) have pledged support for the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) in its fight against corruption, illicit financial flows (IFFs) and kleptocracy. The post ITUC-Africa, NLC pledge support for EFCC to fight corruption appeared first on Tribune Online .
